To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) COVID-19 pandemic has had a severe psychosocial impact on Italians; (2) mental health prevention is the key challenge in the post-emergency phase, especially for vulnerable groups; (3) the importance of the mental health prevention has been underestimated by our government and the media; (4) the COVID-19 pandemic is a lesson to improve mental health prevention in Italy and in Europe.
